# Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

An ADR records a decision that is costly to reverse, with its context and the alternatives
that were rejected (see ADR-0001). ADRs are **topic documents**: when a decision changes,
the ADR of its topic is updated in the same commit as the code; the history is in Git. A new
topic gets a new file: copy `docs/adr/0000-template.md`, take the next free number, then run
`cargo xtask docs --fix`, which regenerates the table below.
